description: This file defines an interface 'ConfigurationInterface' in the Aws\S3\UseArnRegion namespace, specifying methods related to ARN region usage configuration.

classes.name: ConfigurationInterface
classes.description: An interface that declares methods for checking ARN region usage and converting configuration to an array.

methods.name: isUseArnRegion
methods.description: Returns whether the ARN region should be used if it differs from the client configuration.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns the configuration as an associative array.
